provenance.source: Two diagonal searches and a fixed-K/g sweep of a 500-episode RoboTwin 2.0 demo_clean subset on one AutoDL host, built with the record command from their outputs. See issue #87 of MINT-SJTU/RoboScope-Kit.
notes: observed_searches[0] ran the autotune code of main on 44fa1ad; observed_searches[1] ran #81 on 5538408. Both probed K=1, 2, 4, 8, 16 with g=1, stopped when K=16 hit worker_oom, and selected K=8/g=1, so this workload does not separate them. Each probe names its search, and is the first repeat of its K/g in search 0 and the second in search 1.

The evaluation is not Kit's official RoboTwin entry point: a wrapper outside the repository, rw_subset.py, runs episodes 0-9 of each of the 50 demo_clean tasks, 500 episodes in all, without changing Kit code. Every search and fixed run used it on 44fa1ad (Kit 0.8.0b30), on one host with 20 CPU cores by cgroup.

Fixed runs at 8/1 and 10/1 ran three times each: the first in the sweep of 2026-11-07, the other two the next morning (2026-11-08, Beijing time), alternating 8/1, 10/1, 10/1, 8/1. Every completed fixed run reached 187/500 successes.

The fixed runs at 11/1 and 8/2 completed 500 of 500 episodes but lost one Worker to a GPU memory failure ('cannot create buffer' from the SAPIEN camera, after OIDN out of memory at 8/2), so they ran 10 and 7 Workers to the end. Their rates are for that, not for the requested K. A fixed run has no health field to show it.

K=12/g=1 failed in a fixed run when the Policy hit CUBLAS_STATUS_ALLOC_FAILED; K=16/g=1 failed when Workers hit OIDN out of memory, with CUDNN_STATUS_INTERNAL_ERROR on the Policy. Both result files say complete, so their outcomes were set by hand.

The search doubles K, so after K=8 it probes K=16, which runs out of GPU memory, and stops without trying K=10 or K=12. That is why its selection is about 6% below the best fixed run; it holds for main and #81 alike.
All probes are diagonal probes. Default two-phase runs a fixed-size probe, which this record does not cover, so its score here only shows how it would decide on these rates.
evaluation_steps is the 230989 steps of each completed 500-episode fixed run (230990 at 8/2).

unmeasured: Every K/g that no search probed and no fixed run covered.
